title: Don't Fight Velgar Until You Do This! | RuneScape: Dragonwilds Boss Guide
author: Tiger with the Bars
description:
Filmed on launch day, our Velgar Boss Guide for RuneScape: Dragonwilds features our narrator Lord Hooks taking on the game's first major boss completely foodless while using endgame Ancestral armor and Kuldra's Wrath to showcase essential combat mechanics for newcomers.

Even with top tier gear, we strongly recommend that new players level up their Agility before attempting this fight to easily navigate the surrounding terrain and dodge Velgar's strikes. Watch the full breakdown to master the mechanics and conquer Dragonwilds' first great challenge.
